description: This file contains a collection of JavaScript functions used throughout the GUI of the TestLink open source testing management tool. It includes functions for UI interactions, window management, form handling, and integration with other parts of the application such as requirements, test cases, and reports.

classes.name: bug_dialog
classes.description: Class representing a bug dialog with references to window and location, and a flag for refresh control.

classes.name: std_dialog
classes.description: Class representing a standard dialog with optional additional info and refresh control.

methods.name: focusInputField
methods.description: Sets focus to an input element by ID, optionally selecting its content.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays a help div with provided text, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: close_help
methods.description: Removes the help div from the document.

methods.name: open_popup
methods.description: Opens a new browser window with specified page and configuration.

methods.name: ST
methods.description: Shows a test case in the workframe based on ID and version.

methods.name: STS
methods.description: Shows a test suite in the workframe based on ID.

methods.name: SP
methods.description: Loads the main menu URL in the workframe.

methods.name: EP
methods.description: Prepares and loads a test specification for printing.

methods.name: ETS
methods.description: Loads a test suite for editing or printing.

methods.name: ET
methods.description: Loads a specific test case for editing.

methods.name: TPROJECT_PTS
methods.description: Generates a test specification document for a test suite.

methods.name: TPROJECT_PTP
methods.description: Generates a test plan document for a test project.

methods.name: TPROJECT_PTC
methods.description: Generates a test case document from test specification.

methods.name: TPROJECT_PTP_RS
methods.description: Generates all requirement specifications for a project.

methods.name: TPROJECT_PRS
methods.description: Generates a requirement specification with children.

methods.name: ERS
methods.description: Loads the requirement coverage editing page.

methods.name: TPLAN_PTS
methods.description: Prints a test plan for a test suite.

methods.name: TPLAN_PTC
methods.description: Prints a test case from a test plan.

methods.name: showOrHideElement
methods.description: Shows or hides an element by ID.

methods.name: showHideByClass
methods.description: Shows or hides elements by tag name and class.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Handles date selection from date picker.

methods.name: showEventHistoryFor
methods.description: Submits a form to show event history for an object.

methods.name: openReqWindow
methods.description: Opens a requirement in a new window.

methods.name: openTestSuiteWindow
methods.description: Opens a test suite in a new window.

methods.name: get_docs
methods.description: Opens documentation in a new window.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie value by name.

methods.name: storeWindowSize
methods.description: Stores current window size in cookies.

methods.name: scrollToShowMe
methods.description: Scrolls to and focuses an element by ID.

methods.name: openReqRevisionWindow
methods.description: Opens a requirement revision in a new window.

methods.name: openPrintPreview
methods.description: Opens a print preview window for various types.

methods.name: openExecHistoryWindow
methods.description: Opens execution history in a new window.

methods.name: openReqSpecRevisionWindow
methods.description: Opens a requirement spec revision in a new window.

methods.name: openItemWindow
methods.description: Opens a generic item window with configuration.

methods.name: openTCaseWindow
methods.description: Opens a test case in a new window.

methods.name: openLinkedReqWindow
methods.description: Opens a requirement in a new window.

methods.name: openLinkedReqSpecWindow
methods.description: Opens a requirement spec in a new window.

methods.name: TPROJECT_REQ_SPEC_MGMT
methods.description: Launches requirement spec management for a test project.

methods.name: show_hide_column
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a table column.

methods.name: showHideByClass
methods.description: Toggles visibility of elements by tag and class.

methods.name: showEventHistoryFor
methods.description: Submits form to show event history.

methods.name: openTestSuiteWindow
methods.description: Opens test suite in new window.

methods.name: TPROJECT_REQ_SPEC_MGMT
methods.description: Requirement spec management for test project.

methods.name: TPROJECT_REQ_SPEC_MGMT
methods.description: Requirement spec management for test project.
